title: The evidence-first handoff: what a receiving agent needs
summary: Drake briefs agents with a self-contained need, never a chat dump: goal, non-goals, authority and limits, the exact source commit (a branch name moves), the contract and acceptance command, and the evidence the receiver must send back. Reports lead with outcome, revision, change, evidence and limits. I can run a checker that holds a handoff missing any part or lacking an exact commit.
goal: Brief another agent so it can start correctly without your conversation, and get back evidence you can rerun.
key_steps: State authority: what it may and may not touch
Give the exact repository and commit, not a branch
Write the contract and acceptance command
List the evidence to send back, including the negative control
Ask the receiver to explain the task before it starts

example.code:
note handoff: hold a handoff until it carries goal, non-goals, authority, an exact source commit,
note the contract and the evidence the receiver must send back
note exit 0 send, 1 hold, 2 read error
const NF ulong 6
const KSRC ulong 3
const MOK ulong 6
const MMISS ulong 7
const MPASS ulong 8
const MFAIL ulong 9
const MNOPIN ulong 10
text KW "Goal:\nNon-goals:\nAuthority:\nSource:\nContract:\nEvidence back:\n ok\n MISSING\nSEND handoff\nHOLD handoff: the receiver would have to guess\nSource: no exact commit (a branch name moves under you)\n"
note helpers: read all of stdin into inb, walk lines, compare a line prefix with the n-th
note entry of the newline separated table KW, and write table entries, input bytes and numbers
global inb uchar 65536
global num uchar 24
fn rdall to long
t = ulong 0
while lt t len inb bound 65536
k = read 0 inb t sub len inb t
if lt k 0
ret k
end
if eq k 0
ret long t
end
t = add t ulong k
end
ret neg long 27
end
fn eol s ulong n ulong to ulong
i = s
while lt i n bound 65536
if eq get inb i 10
ret i
end
i = add i 1
end
ret n
end
fn kstart k ulong to ulong
p = ulong 0
c = ulong 0
while lt c k bound 4096
if eq get KW p 10
c = add c 1
end
p = add p 1
end
ret p
end
fn klen k ulong to ulong
s = kstart k
i = s
while ne get KW i 10 bound 4096
i = add i 1
end
ret sub i s
end
fn pmat at ulong e ulong k ulong to bool
o = kstart k
m = klen k
if gt m sub e at
ret false
end
for j ulong m
if ne get inb add at j get KW add o j
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
fn emitk o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 4096
w = write 1 KW add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn emiti o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 65536
w = write 1 inb add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn emitn o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 24
w = write 1 num add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn say k ulong to void
emitk kstart k add klen k 1
end
fn word k ulong to void
emitk kstart k klen k
end
fn emitu v ulong to void
p = ulong 24
x = v
while true bound 21
p = sub p 1
put num p uchar add rem x 10 48
x = div x 10
if eq x 0
break
end
end
emitn p sub 24 p
end
fn filled at ulong e ulong to bool
i = at
while lt i e bound 65536
if ne get inb i 32
ret true
end
i = add i 1
end
ret false
end
fn has k ulong n ulong to bool
s = ulong 0
while lt s n bound 65536
e = eol s n
if pmat s e k
if filled add s klen k e
ret true
end
end
s = add e 1
end
ret false
end
fn ishex c uchar to bool
if ge c 48
if le c 57
ret true
end
end
if ge c 97
if le c 102
ret true
end
end
ret false
end
fn pinned at ulong e ulong to bool
run = ulong 0
i = at
while lt i e bound 65536
if ishex get inb i
run = add run 1
if ge run 7
ret true
end
else
run = ulong 0
end
i = add i 1
end
ret false
end
fn srcpin n ulong to bool
s = ulong 0
while lt s n bound 65536
e = eol s n
if pmat s e KSRC
if pinned add s klen KSRC e
ret true
end
end
s = add e 1
end
ret false
end
fn main to int
r = rdall
if lt r 0
ret 2
end
n = ulong r
miss = ulong 0
for k ulong NF
word k
if has k n
say MOK
else
say MMISS
miss = add miss 1
end
end
if has KSRC n
if not srcpin n
say MNOPIN
miss = add miss 1
end
end
if eq miss 0
say MPASS
ret 0
end
say MFAIL
ret 1
end

common_mistake: Briefing by reference ('continue from above', 'same as before') or asking for a summary back. Fix: write all six parts with the exact commit and ask for commands, statuses and output.

links.title: omega-mv AGENTS.md (an instruction file a receiver reads first)

evidence_note: The example ran on a Linux AArch64 host (no GPU) and its output is recorded byte for byte with a negative control. Rests on the recorded run of handoff.om: a complete handoff is sent, a chat dump and a branch-only source are held with exit 1. NOT done: the checker checks structure only; it marked 'see the conversation above' as present, and judging content stays with a reviewer.
